title: Technician filter on the expanded technician charts
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  1. You are signed in as an Admin (the Admin role has every permission, including Reports).
  2. You are in one location (workplace) with the data below.
  3. You use a desktop browser at 100% zoom on a screen at least 1024 pixels wide (any ordinary laptop or desktop monitor).
  4. At least two technicians have clocked time on invoiced work order lines this month in this location.

Setup

  • For 1: on the QA site's sign-in page, in the DEV MODE — QUICK LOGIN panel, click Admin (this signs you in as Admin ShopView). To use another role, check it has Reports: profile icon > Settings > Roles & Permissions > edit icon on the role > Reports is switched on.
  • For 2: to change location, click your profile icon (your initials, top right, beside the current location name) > under Change Location: click the orange button showing the current location > pick the location from the list. On the QA site use Staging Heavy Duty - 9919 unless a later line says otherwise.
  • For 4: check: Technician Efficiency (This Month) > View details: the table lists at least two technicians. If not, create an invoice with clocked time for each technician: first with Tech ShopView: Customers > New Customer > Name > Save (for example ZZAUTOTEST Dash Customer); Work Orders > Create Work Order > in the New Work Order window pick the Customer and an Asset (Add beside either if needed) > Save (if a Confirmation says the customer is over their credit limit, click Create); the New Line window opens: What Are You Doing? (any text), Add Technician = Tech ShopView, Labor Rate = EVR Travel to EVO ($100 an hour), Estimated Time 1 and Tech Time 1, tick Line Approved > Save & Close; then the Service Advisor is filled in with your name (Admin ShopView); to use another advisor change Service Advisor in the work order's left panel; clock time as the technician: in a second browser or a private window, on the QA site's sign-in page, in the DEV MODE — QUICK LOGIN panel, click Tech (this signs you in as Tech ShopView, a technician at Staging Heavy Duty - 9919 with Time Clock on); open the work order > on the line's Labor row click Start; when done click Stop > Clock Out; to make the time exact, as Admin: the three dots at the top right of the Lines tab > Timesheets (n) > edit the record's start and end (if it cannot be edited there or in Reports > Timesheet Activities, keep the real time and use the hours Timesheet Activities shows); on the line click Story (Add tech story for this line) > type a short story > Update; click Complete (if a Missing Details window asks for Mileage, enter one > Complete All Lines); click Mark Reviewed; Finance tab > Create Invoice; close the New Customer Payment window without paying (do not send or pay the invoice). Then create a second technician you can sign in as: profile icon > Settings > Staff > New Staff Member: a name (for example ZZAUTOTEST Tech Two), an Email you can open, Role Technician, a Department, Location = this location, Time Clock on > Save & Close; accept the invitation email and set a password, and repeat with a second customer and that technician.
custom_steps:
1. Click Dashboard in the top bar.
  2. On the Technician Efficiency tile, click View details.
  3. Read the filter button at the top right of the chart.
  4. Click the filter button and read the list.
  5. Untick every technician except two (keep any two).
  6. Close the list and read the chart's legend and lines.
  7. Click View details on the Technician Utilization tile.
  8. Repeat the last four steps on the Technician Utilization chart.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Each of the two technician charts has a Technician filter, reading Technician: All technicians before you change it.
  • The list lets you tick more than one technician, and every technician starts ticked.
  • After keeping two technicians the chart reloads and shows only those two: the legend names only them and only two lines are drawn.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-490; story SV-9580 (Story 8, Chart Filters); Dashboard v1 PRD, Confluence 788430850 v42, read 7 Oct 2026, Story 8. Design canvas (claude.ai/artifact/Wae9DFQ8PJQBy8mbLsL5ge, screenshots of the SV-8311 build captured 2026-09-28) boards 06_TechEff_After and 07_TechUtil_After, used for on-screen labels only.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S8-R1: “The Technician Efficiency and Technician Utilization charts each have a Technician filter.”
  • S8-R2: “The Technician filter lets the user select any number of technicians and defaults to all technicians selected.”
  • S8-R5: “When the user changes a chart filter, the chart reloads scoped to the selected technicians or advisor.”

Last checked against build v26.39.1-09be696 on 10/2/2026.
